scene_1.text_1: Use a cardboard box containing a cat on the Shafts.
scene_1.text_2: First make a Cute Cat on a Shaft, then add bread and butter.
scene_1.text_3: The more butter you add, the greater its kinetic output.
scene_1.text_4: And with super butter? Perpetual motion machine.
scene_1.title: Let the Butter Cat spin around!
